one_line: An unnamed 8th-century master architect of the Pratihara age, shaping temples at Gwalior, Osian and Bateshwar.

appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown North Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp but kind eyes with slightly thick brows, neatly trimmed moustache, default expression focused and thoughtful with a calm, modest smile
appearance.hair: black hair parted in the middle, pulled back into a short low bun at the nape wrapped in a narrow off-white cloth band, with a simple turmeric-yellow fabric headband tied around the forehead
appearance.costume: era-accurate Pratihara-period craftsman attire: a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic with a slight overlap tied at the right side, long sleeves rolled to mid-forearm, paired with ankle-length straight cotton dhoti-style lower garment in muted sandalwood-beige, pleats drawn forward and tucked firmly; a narrow woven cotton sash in deep rust-red wraps around the waist twice and knots on the left hip with short loose ends; a light, plain, undyed cotton uttariya (shawl) rests over both shoulders and drapes down the back, occasionally looping over the left forearm; simple leather sandals on the feet; minimal jewellery—one thin copper torque-style neck ring and a single small copper stud earring in the left ear—kept practical and modest.
appearance.signature: A wooden architectural measuring rod marked with carved notches, held in the right hand, and a small rolled palm-leaf plan tucked under the left arm with a faint sketched shikhara outline visible.

ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown Pratihara sthapati with oval face, black bun wrapped in cloth, off-white angarkha, beige dhoti, rust-red waist sash, turmeric-yellow headband, cotton shawl, simple copper jewellery, carrying a wooden measuring rod and palm-leaf plan in warm neutral colours.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of an 8th-century Pratihara architect from Gwalior: a lean, medium-brown man in his mid-30s with an oval face, sharp but kind eyes, straight nose and a neat moustache, black hair pulled into a short low bun at the nape wrapped in a narrow off-white cloth band, plus a turmeric-yellow headband tied around his forehead. He wears a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic, long sleeves rolled to mid-forearm, over an ankle-length sandalwood-beige dhoti-style lower garment with forward pleats, cinched by a narrow rust-red woven waist sash wrapped twice and knotted on his left hip. A plain undyed cotton shawl drapes over both shoulders and down his back, and he stands in simple leather sandals. He has minimal jewellery: a thin copper torque-like neck ring and a single small copper stud in his left ear. In his right hand he holds a wooden architectural measuring rod with carved notches, while a rolled palm-leaf plan with a faint temple tower sketch is tucked under his left arm. Use a warm, historically grounded palette of off-white, sandalwood beige, rust red, turmeric yellow and medium brown, and show him front-facing in a neutral pose so his face, hairstyle, clothing details and tools are all clearly visible.
